mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions": plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts, and internal hosts are held to the same HTTPS requirement as every other host. This supersedes the earlier note that allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts, and it sits alongside the standing decision to keep certificate verification enabled on all builds.
EOF
